node.title: L1 boundary-Q planted-root descent
node.statement: For an exact member P in a boundary affine-Q cell, the basis determinant gives W1 P-N1=c_P L, where L is its complete agreement locator. With D=gcd(W1,Omega), the module congruence gives D|N1, every D-root is a planted agreement, and D|L. Dividing by D leaves a root-free projective rational-Q cell on H\roots(D). If r=deg D>=k there is at most one member; if r<k, candidates are uniquely P=P_S+D R with deg R<k-r, while the split locator degree falls from m to m-r, preserving surplus w. No smoothness or transport to standard locator Q is proved.
